en: Black‑and‑white image of a quiet residential street lined with newly built middle‑class houses in a similar historicist/early 20th‑century style. The homes have steep tiled roofs, dormers, bay windows, small balconies and fenced front gardens. Young trees stand at regular intervals along the sidewalk. A man walks on the left side of the road and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the street. The road is unpaved and there are no motor vehicles, giving the scene an early 1900s suburban feel.
